analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Forming a cup and handle with a 23.3% depth and 6.8% handle above rising 21, 50, and 200 SMAs. RSI 53 and positive MACD show base consolidation, but volume dry-up on the pivot remains essential before breakout confirmation.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite reported top-line expansion to 137.2 Cr, core operations remain in deficit with Q2 FY27 net loss of 47.6 Cr. Weak return profile (ROCE 2.5%, ROE 1.5%) and earnings distorted by other income disqualify it under CANSLIM rules.
63MOONS.risk: Failure to hold stop at 880.20 or invalidation below the 50-DMA confirms base failure, requiring immediate risk-off exit.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a double bottom with bullish engulfing price action above key EMAs and 200-SMA. RSI 54 reflects neutral momentum, though relative strength remains subpar without high-volume institutional accumulation.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction with Q1 FY27 sales sliding 56.3% YoY to 44.6 Cr and net profit down 25.5% to 1.02 Cr. Thin EBITDA margin of 1.6% and poor ROE (3.1%) highlight absence of CANSLIM growth traits.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Breach of 103.61 stop level breaks base support, triggering instantaneous stop-loss discipline.

ACUTAAS.technical: Constructive double bottom with price holding firmly above the 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA trend template. RSI at 68 confirms expanding relative strength, and positive MACD supports a high-quality pivot breakout attempt toward 4,049.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: High-grade CANSLIM metrics: Q2 FY27 net sales climbed 42.7% YoY to 436.9 Cr, while PAT surged 71.4% to 123.1 Cr. Robust EBITDA margins of ~40% and solid CDMO/pharma intermediate expansion underpin superior institutional sponsorship.
ACUTAAS.risk: Close below 3637.50 invalidates the pivot structure, demanding immediate loss containment per Minervini risk parameters.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Clearing a 20-day high above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 59 and positive MACD. However, overhead supply from multi-month consolidation requires heavy follow-through volume to establish sustained Stage 2 continuation.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Operational revenue jumped 41.6% YoY to 4,258 Cr in Q2 FY27, yet consolidated net profit slowed to +16.0% YoY due to elevated finance costs (2,119 Cr). High leverage and single-digit ROCE (7.4%) temper CANSLIM quality.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Drop below 1329.50 breaks 20-day breakout support and EMA21, requiring rapid position exit.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Classic Stage 2 leadership breakout to fresh trailing-year highs on 1.29x volume. Moving averages are sequentially aligned above the 200-DMA, and RSI confirms healthy upward momentum without overbought exhaustion.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Solid steady execution with Q2 FY27 revenue up 23.7% YoY to 11,340 Cr and PAT up 16.5% to 3,682 Cr. Strong 60% EBITDA margin and increased FY27 management guidance offset sub-25% EPS growth.
ADANIPORTS.risk: A break below 1776.35 invalidates the breakout bar, enforcing Minervini's strict loss-cutting protocol.

AEROFLEX.technical: Bullish double bottom with a Vibha Jha 3-up confirmation off the 21-EMA and 50-DMA confluence. Momentum is fully aligned with positive MACD and firm support above all key moving averages, poised for pivot expansion.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Phenomenal CANSLIM credentials: Q2 FY27 sales surged 87% YoY to 207.7 Cr while PAT skyrocketed 157% to 36.6 Cr. High EBITDA margins of 24.3% driven by rapid data-center liquid cooling demand provide stellar institutional appeal.
AEROFLEX.risk: A violation of 529.97 breaches the 50-DMA and base floor, mandating immediate capital protection.
